messages:
sam_newhire: Hey team — quick onboarding Qs. I'm remote and live out of state. Can I do the I-9 with an authorized agent/notary, or do I need to come to a Redwood office? Also my BG check shows a name mismatch (maiden name on prior employer) 1 how do we resolve that? Lastly: is there a travel stipend for an in-person orientation if I choose to fly in?

 tara_peopleops: Welcome, Sam! :wave: For I-9: remote hires can use an authorized agent in your area for Section 2 verification. We send the agent form, you check their details, they sign, and you upload the signed document to Workday. If you prefer to fly in for an on-site verification we can reimburse travel per policy (see below).

 sam_newhire: Nice. What docs does the agent need to see? Passport ok? And how does reimbursement work?

 tara_peopleops: Agent needs to inspect the same acceptable documents as in-person verifiers (passport OR DL + SSN card). We'll email a PDF with instructions and a sample completed form to give the agent. Reimbursement: file expense in Concur within 30 days, tag "Onboard-Travel" and attach boarding + hotel receipts. Economy fare up to $700 and up to $150/night for hotel unless you get manager pre-approval.

 sam_newhire: Got it, thanks. About the BG name mismatch 1 I used my maiden name at a prior employer. I uploaded a marriage certificate with my offer packet; is that enough?

 hr_bot: Background check (sam_newhire): FLAGGED for name variance. Required docs: government-issued ID (current) + legal name change proof (marriage cert, court order). Please upload to Workday HR Docs. Ref: BG-8894.

 tara_peopleops: Yep the marriage certificate should resolve it. Upload it to Workday under "Supporting Documents" and reply here once done so we can re-run verification.

 devon_it: FYI laptop shipment scheduled Wed via vendor (track: https://ship.redwood.internal/track/RY-9931). If you're remote we'll ship to your home address and include a return label for staging/recall. If you travel to the office we can hold for pickup.

 sam_newhire: If I fly in, can I get day-of access for a meeting room? I might need the office for paperwork and a quiet spot.

 security_bot: Visitor access note: temporary badge can be issued same day at security desk after ID verification. For a pre-provisioned day badge for a new hire, we need the I-9 completed (or agent form uploaded and approved) and laptop assigned. If you need a reserved room, ping lucas_ops with desired time and office location.

 lucas_ops: Can do. If you give me a window (9am-3pm) and office location we'll book a small conference room and set up a desk. Also confirm if you need video conferencing gear.

 sam_newhire: I'll likely arrive 8pm Sun, need a room Mon 9-12 in SF office, and a desk to sign forms. No A/V needed.

 tara_peopleops: Noted. Sam: checklist for remote hires flying in (copy/paste):
```
- Choose: in-person I-9 OR authorized agent (if agent: confirm agent contact and upload signed form)
- Upload marriage certificate to Workday to clear BG name mismatch
- Book travel; save receipts for Concur reimbursement (label: Onboard-Travel)
- Expect laptop Wed; request hold at reception if arriving earlier
- Arrive Mon 9am SF office for orientation; temporary badge issued at security after verification
- Reservation: Conf B reserved 9-12; desk set at IT drop-in
- Benefits: Workday enrollment email triggers on first day (30 days to enroll)
```

 sam_newhire: Thanks everyone! I'll upload the marriage cert tonight and confirm travel by EOD Friday. Appreciate the help :pray: 

 devon_it: If you want early VPN access for setup, DM me a copy of your ID after upload and I'll pre-create the account (will still require 2FA enrollment on first login).

 tara_peopleops: Great. We'll re-run the BG after you upload. If anything blocks on our side we'll DM you directly.
